user.title: Set up HomeAI
user.description: HomeAI notices what changes in your home, decides what to do, fixes what it can and tells you only when a person is needed. It works without AI; AI tiers can be added later as subentries.

data_description.privacy: Standard sends device, room and people names. Minimal replaces people and rooms with neutral labels. Full also sends calendar event titles.

people.title: People
people.description: Choose each person's role. Administrators approve risky actions and configuration changes; members get notifications; guests and ignored people are not tracked as residents. People: {people}

abort.single_instance_allowed: HomeAI is already set up. Only one instance is allowed.

init.title: HomeAI quick settings
init.description: All other settings are in the HomeAI panel.

abort.not_loaded: HomeAI is not running. Reload the integration and try again.

bad_signal.message: The signal is not valid. Check the ID, title and severity.

person_required.message: Only a person can approve or deny, not an automation.

approval_unavailable.message: This request is no longer pending, or you may not decide it.

plan_invalid.message: The plan entry was not saved: {reason}.

presence_invalid.message: The presence exception was not saved: {reason}.

admin_required.message: Only an administrator can do this.

situation_unknown.message: There is no such open situation.

report_signal.name: Report a signal
report_signal.description: Tells HomeAI about something it cannot detect by itself. HomeAI treats it like its own observations: correlates, triages and notifies.

id.name: ID
id.description: Stable identifier; reporting the same ID again updates the signal.

category.name: Category
category.description: What kind of matter it is.

need.name: Who is needed
need.description: Nobody, any household member, an administrator or a technician.

group.name: Group
group.description: Signals with the same group form one situation.

expires_minutes.name: Expires after
expires_minutes.description: Clear the signal automatically after this time.

clear_signal.name: Clear a signal
clear_signal.description: Clears a signal reported earlier with Report a signal.

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: “Got it”: stops notifications for a situation, or for all open situations when none is given.

situation_id.name: Situation ID
situation_id.description: Leave empty for all open situations.

handle.name: Take care of it
handle.description: “I'll handle it”: acknowledges the situation and assigns it to the caller.

situation_id.name: Situation ID
situation_id.description: Leave empty for all open situations.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Pauses notifications about a situation for a while.

situation_id.name: Situation ID
situation_id.description: Leave empty for all open situations.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Defaults to the snooze time in settings.

dismiss.name: Not a problem
dismiss.description: Closes a situation and ignores its signals for the configured number of days. HomeAI learns from it.

send_digest.name: Send digest
send_digest.description: Sends the summary of open matters now.

approve.name: Approve
approve.description: Approves an action HomeAI asked about. Residents may approve comfort and device actions, administrators everything else.

deny.name: Deny
deny.description: Refuses an action HomeAI asked about.

undo.name: Undo
undo.description: Restores the states from before a comfort or device action.

plan_add.name: Add to the plan
plan_add.description: Adds an action or a reminder to the home's plan. People who are not administrators may plan only simple device actions.

reminder.name: Reminder
reminder.description: Instead of an action: a message sent to people.

kind.name: Repeat
kind.description: Once, daily, on chosen weekdays, or relative to the sun.

time.name: Time
time.description: Local time for once, daily and weekly.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Minutes before (negative) or after the sun event.

skip_when_away.name: Skip when nobody is home
skip_when_away.description: Do not run while everyone is away.

plan_remove.name: Remove from the plan
plan_remove.description: Removes a plan entry. People who are not administrators may remove only their own.

plan_skip.name: Skip a day
plan_skip.description: Skips one day of a repeating plan entry.

presence_add.name: Add a presence exception
presence_add.description: A trip, guests, working from home or sickness, for one person or the household.

ask.name: Ask HomeAI
ask.description: Asks HomeAI in the caller's account and returns the answer. Actions go through HomeAI's policy.

text.name: Question
text.description: What to ask or ask for.

conversation_id.name: Conversation
conversation_id.description: Keeps a thread across calls; empty: one thread per caller.

run_mission.name: Run a mission
run_mission.description: Runs a HomeAI mission now: assessment, investigation or arbitration of a situation, the digest, the weekly review or nightly learning. Administrators and automations only.

user.title: Add an AI tier
user.description: P1 is the everyday brain (cheap or local), P2 investigates harder matters, P3 is the arbiter for the most difficult decisions. Several tiers of the same level are tried in order of priority.

details.title: {tier} settings
details.description: The connection is checked without spending tokens.

data_description.effort: How deeply the model thinks. Higher costs more.
data_description.fallbacks: If the model declines, the server retries on a suitable model.
data_description.price_input: Dollars per million tokens; empty: the known price (local: free).
data_description.timeout: Empty: the HomeAI AI timeout setting.
data_description.budget_daily: When this connection spends it, the next one of the tier is tried. Empty: only the HomeAI budgets.

error.unknown_model: The provider does not know this model.

no_residents.title: HomeAI knows no residents
no_residents.description: No person has the role administrator or member, so nobody gets notifications and presence is unknown. Set roles in the HomeAI panel (Settings → Presence) or add people in Home Assistant.

no_phones.title: HomeAI cannot reach anyone
no_phones.description: None of the residents has a phone with the Home Assistant app or a notify target. Install the Companion app or add notify targets per person in the HomeAI panel.

no_areas.title: HomeAI does not know your rooms
no_areas.description: There are no areas in Home Assistant. With areas HomeAI says where things happen, groups related problems and targets actions; add them in Settings → Areas.
